objective_interpretation: The review treats the pricing page and trial signup as a conversion decision for a budget-conscious evaluator, not as a general product review.

activated_modules.reason: How the pricing model is framed is itself a positioning choice.
A team lead and a finance approver weigh the same pricing page differently.
The pricing page has to justify the model, not just state it.
Pricing only reads as a choice against what comparable tools charge.
The subscription itself, and how it is packaged, is the subject of the decision.
The decision is explicitly about the pricing page.
Trial signup is the acquisition mechanism this review is asked to improve.
Signup friction is the second half of the stated decision.
The pricing page and signup flow are both web pages.

dormant_modules.reason: No blog or writing corpus bears on a pricing and signup decision.
Not raised in the objective; a separate review would need to establish this before it belonged here.
No compliance driver was raised, and the pages are simple checkout-style forms.
The decision is about visitors who already arrived, not about being found.
The analytics tooling market's trends are not what this decision turns on.
No press or third-party sentiment signal was anticipated going in.
No security or compliance concern was raised for this audience or this decision.

anticipated_gaps: No analytics access, so the actual drop-off point in signup cannot be observed directly.
